reason: Fixed mock.setItem in createStorageMock: wrapped Storage.prototype.setItem.call(this, ...) in try-catch. In jsdom 26.1.0 on Node 26, the instanceof Storage check in Storage.prototype.setItem throws TypeError when 'this' is a mock object created via Object.create(Storage.prototype). The try-catch catches this error while still allowing: (a) the spy to be triggered when prototype call succeeds, and (b) data to be stored locally when it fails.
